AP01.definition: Direct multimarker where possible; moving-COLMAP relay only where required.

AP02.definition: Distortion-aware reference-marker graph bundle adjustment with soft-L1; no hard residual rejection.

AP03.definition: Grouped calibrated targetless COLMAP with ArUco marker-size metric scaling.

note: This shared baseline is the Route-2 dataset with the extended ArUco layout. FOV, resolution, motion-blur, frame-density and lighting ablations must derive from this baseline route.
